## What's Changed

- Adds the `audio_sync` transcode profile to authenticated Local Media music
  streams.
- Normalizes mixed-player music to deterministic 48 kHz, 16-bit stereo PCM so
  AirPlay devices and Tater native satellites receive the same decoded audio
  timeline.
- Keeps normal music playback on direct play; clients must explicitly request
  `transcode=1&profile=audio_sync`.
- Reports Audio Sync PCM sessions through the existing Tater Tube stream and
  transcode activity tracking.

## Upgrade

Pull the latest container and restart:

```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/tatertotterson/tater-tube-server:latest
docker restart tater-tube-server
```

No database migration is required. A compatible Tater Music Core automatically
requests the new profile only when native Tater satellites and AirPlay players
are selected together.
